capabilities: Score notes by recency, connections, and word count
Group notes into a folder-based knowledge map
Categorize notes as healthy, stale, or forgotten
Suggest a maintenance action per note
Filter and search notes by health category
disambiguation: Not an activity or contribution-calendar heatmap; it maps note-maintenance scores across folders and notes.
extras: Read-only and fully local with no network, telemetry, account, or API key; it never edits notes. README says installation is 'after the plugin is accepted into the Obsidian community directory,' so it may not yet be listed. Physical iOS/Android testing not yet done; only desktop and mobile emulation were exercised.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to spot which notes across a large vault are stale, under-connected, or overdue for maintenance.
summary: Local-first dashboard that scores note maintenance health from recency, connections, and word count, flagging stale or forgotten notes.
